result.summary: 这篇论文提出“柏拉图表示假说”，认为不同深度网络对数据的表示正在趋同，并可能收敛到对现实世界联合分布的共享统计模型 [abstract][S1.p4]。作者综述了文献中跨架构、跨模态以及与人脑对齐的证据，并用78个视觉模型和多种语言模型测量表示对齐，发现对齐随模型能力、规模和任务多样性增加而提高 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS3.p4]。论文进一步提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种可能驱动收敛的机制，并给出一个以点互信息为相似度的理想化世界模型 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2][S4.SS2.p7]。作者还讨论了该假说的局限，包括不同模态可能包含不同信息、并非所有表示目前都在收敛、专用智能可能不收敛以及对齐度量本身存在争议 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要回答的核心问题是：不同AI模型（尤其是深度网络）的表示是否正在收敛，以及这种收敛是否朝向一个共享的、对现实世界统计模型的表示 [abstract][S1.p4]。作者指出，AI系统在架构和能力上正变得越来越同质化，因此需要检验这种趋同是否存在终点和驱动原则 [S1.p1][S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: We argue that representations in AI models, particularly deep networks, are converging.
Our central hypothesis, stated above in Figure 1, is that there is indeed an endpoint to this convergence and a principle that drives it
AI systems are becoming increasingly homogeneous in both their architectures and their capabilities.

method.text: 论文将表示定义为向量嵌入，并用其诱导的核（相似度结构）来刻画，表示对齐则定义为两个核之间的相似度 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者采用互最近邻等核对齐度量来测量模型间的表示对齐，并综述了模型拼接等已有证据 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S2.SS1.p3]。此外，论文提出一个理想化世界模型，其中事件序列从未知分布采样，观测是双射确定性函数，并论证某些对比学习算法可能收敛到以点互信息为相似度的嵌入 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS2.p7]。

evidence.quote: We restrict our attention to representations that are vector embeddings.
we define representational alignment as a measure of the similarity of the similarity structures induced by two representations
they measured representational similarity through a technique called model stitching
The world consists of a sequence of $T$ discrete events, denoted as $\mathbf{Z}\triangleq[z_{1},\ldots,z_{T}]$, sampled from some unknown distribution $\mathbb{P}(\mathbf{Z})$.
find an embedding in which similarity equals PMI

experiments.text: 在视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者评估了78个视觉模型，包括17个ViT、1个随机初始化ResNet-50、11个ResNet-50和49个ResNet-18，在Places-365验证集上计算k=10互最近邻对齐，并在19个VTAB分类任务上做线性探测 [A3.SS1.p1][A3.SS1.p2][A3.SS1.p3]。在跨模态对齐方面，作者在Wikipedia caption数据集（WIT）上测量语言模型与视觉模型的对齐，语言模型性能用OpenWebText上4M token的1-bits-per-byte衡量 [S2.F3]。此外，作者还进行了颜色共现实验，从CIFAR-10像素共现和语言共现中学习颜色表示，并与CIELAB感知空间比较 [A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We consider 78 vision models in total
we evaluate linear probing performance on all 19 VTAB classification tasks
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over $1000$ image representations computed on Places-365’s validation dataset
We measure alignment using mutual nearest-neighbor on the Wikipedia caption dataset (WIT).
The x-axis is the language model performance measured over 4M tokens from the OpenWebText dataset
We collect color cooccurrence statistics from the CIFAR-10 dataset

findings.text: 论文发现，视觉模型中迁移性能高的模型形成紧密聚类的表示，而弱性能模型的表示更可变 [S2.SS2.p2]。跨模态上，语言模型与视觉模型的对齐随语言建模性能提高而增强，且CLIP模型因显式语言监督对齐更高，但在ImageNet分类微调后对齐下降 [S2.F3]。对齐还能预测下游性能：与DINOv2对齐更好的LLM在Hellaswag和GSM8K上表现更好 [S2.F4]。在颜色案例中，从图像或文本共现统计学习到的表示大致恢复相同的感知颜色表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: models with high transfer performance form a tightly clustered set of representations, while models with weak performance have more variable representations
more capable language models align better with more capable vision models
We find that CLIP models, which are trained with explicit language supervision, exhibit a higher level of alignment.
However, this alignment decreases after being fine-tuned on ImageNet classification
We observe that models aligned more closely with vision also show better performance on downstream language tasks.
learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation

limitations.text: 作者明确承认，不同模态可能包含不同信息，若输入信号信息不同，两个模型无法收敛到相同表示 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。目前并非所有表示都在收敛，例如机器人领域尚无标准化的世界状态表示方式 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。专用智能可能不收敛，因为窄任务之间可能共享很少，且捷径表示可能更高效 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1]。对齐度量本身存在争议，作者主要使用互最近邻，但其他度量可能给出不同结果 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]。此外，作者指出对齐分数仅达到0.16（理论最大为1），这是强对齐还是弱对齐仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

evidence.quote: Two different models cannot converge to the same representation if they have access to fundamentally different information.
in robotics there is not yet a standardized approach to representing world states
Our argument only holds for intelligences that are optimized to perform well on many tasks.
there is active debate on the merits and deficiencies of all these ways of measuring alignment
alignment clearly increases but only reaches a score of $0.16$
We leave this as an open question.
